notes: «أن ابن عمر ... كان يبيت» describes Ibn Umar's conduct, not his words, so he is not a link (rule 6); the chain ends at Nafi

fixes.reason: K6I's narrator index ends at Ibn Umar, but the text describes his conduct and gives none of his words, so the reading stops at Nafi.
